subject: English
question_text: Complete the text with suitable prepositions.
stimulus: We should muse (a) ----- our way of life. We take everything in a such way as if we triumphed (b) ----- death. We shall not be given any chance to escape (c) ----- death. We are now running after our own shadow to grasp (d) ----- it but in vain. If we waste our time boastfully violating the laws of Allah, the death will revenge (e) ----- us within a very short time.
guide_solution: Use of prepositions: (a) on/upon; (b) over; (c) from; (d) at; (e) on/upon.
